title: The claims ledger lock clears a stale lock file once, so two waiters never both hold it
goal: bl_dispatch.ledger_lock clears a lock file older than LEDGER_LOCK_STALE_S only when it is still the file it judged stale (an owner token or an atomic rename), so two waiters that both see a stale lock never enter the read-modify-write together
notes: Found by the SP-g2ssvhi2 review (S3): bl_dispatch.py:519-523; waiter A unlinks the stale lock and creates a fresh one, waiter B (holding the old stat) unlinks A's fresh lock and creates its own, and both are inside. Only a crashed writer's leftover lock opens the window.
